description: This PHP class 'AllowedPermission' encapsulates permission settings for read, create, update, and delete operations within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to create permission objects from an array and to query individual permissions.

classes.name: AllowedPermission
classes.description: A class representing permission flags for CRUD operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize permission flags with default values.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates an instance of AllowedPermission from an associative array.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Returns whether read permission is granted.

methods.name: canCreate
methods.description: Returns whether create permission is granted.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Returns whether update permission is granted.

methods.name: canDelete
methods.description: Returns whether delete permission is granted.
